ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity (white/off-white) and 35% low-intensity (black) pixel coverage on the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white lobes bisected by a centralized, low-intensity black patch that extends laterally from the median notch in an anvil-shaped distribution. Low-intensity black pixels define the entire perimeter of the trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression; visible angle approximately 45 degrees, apex partially submerged.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrations across the full span of the trailing edge. Distinct jagged protrusions and non-uniform pixel-depth variations (notches) are concentrated along the upper boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward curvature from the central notch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible high-contrast circular 'O' mark (dark ring) on the mid-right lobe. Scattered low-density, dark-pixel punctate spots localized on the interior white surfaces of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible reddish-brown, high-texture protrusion on the distal tip of the left lobe, indicating non-pigmentary organic growth or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Diffuse yellowish-brown staining visible across the lower-central high-intensity regions of both lobes.
